selection_protocol.amplitude_ties: max global pair count, max sum score, then lower requested delta
selection_protocol.grouping: greedy same-WL edges by descending shared G window, then WL/BL coordinates; at most31 two-input merges
selection_protocol.heldout: map frozen before independent3 repeats; all nonempty masks; no refit or map filtering
selection_protocol.linearity: basis-only least-squares through zero across mean ADC responses versus native decoded increments
selection_protocol.matching_ties: edge scores rounded12 decimals; max pair count, max sum score, lexicographically smallest WL pairs
selection_protocol.no_multiinput: keep all selected pairs and flag absence; never silently discard cells
selection_protocol.noise_penalty: max(1,hypot(legSDs))+maxAbsDriftPlus+maxAbsDriftMinus+linearityResidualPlus+linearityResidualMinus; +5 per leg if fewer than3 safe amplitudes
selection_protocol.selection: maximum cardinality positive historical G overlap, then sum edge scores; no labels
